notes: The Imperial Library also exposes large game-category collections. Category membership alone is not sufficient to classify a page as dialogue.
Pages containing dialogue inside an in-world written work belong to the books/text corpus unless they are a transcription of spoken game dialogue.

classification_rules: Require evidence of spoken/interactive transcript structure before assigning a dialogue source_kind.
Keep scripted player prompts separate from player-character narration added by a transcriber.
For ESO, retain chapter/DLC/quest metadata where discoverable because the corpus is large and evolves by release.
A page released in multiple games can be cross-linked but should not be duplicated as dialogue unless it actually transcribes dialogue.
